label: wage-probe3
_why: Does `is_subject_of = c:TAG` actually filter, or is it silently ignored? An invalid trigger inside a `limit` is a NO-OP rather than an error (TESTBED_METRICS 3.7), so a broken test would leave only the market limit - which is precisely the unbounded sweep this change exists to prevent. BEL and AUS cannot answer it: at 1836 their market IS their lead plus subjects, so both designs give the same count. BIC discriminates. The East India Company sits INSIDE the 3 242-pop British market but has its own small subject tree, so: filter works => a few hundred pops; filter ignored => exactly 3 242.
_expected: BEL 187 (no subjects), AUS 895 (Hungary + Croatia-Slavonia + Transylvania + Krakow), BIC well under 3 242. Each group's own WC lines give the independent expected count to check against.
_cost: One control run, 1836.2.1 -> 1836.4.1. About two minutes.
